jobs_results.title: Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
SDG Group is a global Consulting firm specialising in Data & Analytics. We are committed to unlocking an organisations’ potential and hidden value by offering in-depth analytics expertise that empowers our clients’ business models to become successful data-driven enterprises. Innovation is in our DNA. We constantly innovate our value proposition with cutting-edge laboratories and transformational models to provide the ultimate analytics practices and solutions.

SDG Group works on the pillars of Triple Expertise, incorporating business process skills by domain with technical knowledge and partnership with the most important and innovative software providers. Our portfolio also features cutting-edge laboratories and the development of Advanced Analytics & AI technologies.

Why Join Us?


We’re looking for problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators who want to be a part of the mission to help us to further grow our company! You will have the ability to learn the latest technologies in the market and build strong relationships with technical and business leaders, all while deepening your expertise and enhancing your skills.


We will work with you to create customised career plans which will allow you to grow independently, as well as with your colleagues. If you value inclusivity and want to join a culture that empowers you to show up as your authentic self, join us.

About The Data Analyst Role


 

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for analysing data using statistical techniques, implementing and maintaining databases, gathering data from primary and secondary sources and identifying, analysing and interpreting trends from the data.

What You’ll Be Doing


In collaboration with the other members of your team and your Manager, you will be in charge of, or participate in the following activities:



Business requirements mapping to functional and technical design
Data structure analysis and data model design
Development of data transformation processes
Implementation of metrics and visualisations
Front-end and user interface development
Working with team members by converting business requirements to achieve functional and technical design
Ideally you will be able to offer



Relevant Bachelor’s Degree (Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Business Technology, STEM, etc.)
Strong passion for data and technology with the aspiration to work in Management Consulting
Demonstrable experience using SQL, Python or related languages
Some knowledge of BI technologies, data modeling, data management
At least 12 months Commercial experience in data analysis, data technology, business intelligence, analytics
Experience working with modern Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Data Management technologies
Outstanding oral and written communication skills
Ability and willingness to digest technical business information and present that with sensitivity to business stakeholders
Ability to build strong relationship with internal team members and client team
Productivity and autonomy, eager to accept challenges

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst - Specialty
jobs_results.description: Who are we? Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries. People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden. Role Overview Role Overview The role is dedicated to the Aviation team. Its primary focus is to support our Senior Data Analyst, Aviation and ultimately the wider Aviation team with data analysis, reporting and analytics; all of the role’s deliverables relate to the aviation portfolio. For the first year, you will spend dedicated time each week embedded with the central Data & Analytics team. That team provides the formal training, tooling and access to the “back end” — the data lake, SQL and detailed data-analytical environment — that sits behind the Aviation team’s reporting, and the role applies that capability directly to Aviation work. The Aviation team’s data function is currently led by deep domain knowledge — over 20 years of aviation insurance experience across claims, finance, broking and account management — together with a clear understanding of the data and the outputs the team needs. This role complements that domain expertise with formal analytical and technical depth (data-lake access, SQL and structured data analysis), developed and supported through the Data & Analytics team. In summary: Focus: dedicated to Aviation team data, reporting and analytics. Working pattern: approximately 25% of each week embedded with the Data & Analytics team. Development model: technical training, tooling and back-end (data lake / SQL) access provided by the Data & Analytics team and applied directly to Aviation work. What You’ll Do Work with brokers and business stakeholders to understand real-world problems and translate them into data and AI questions. Explore and prototype data ideas, helping to shape user stories and analytical approaches. Clean, analyse and validate data from multiple sources — including premium and placement data, claims experience and underwriter / portfolio performance — to ensure accuracy and reliability. Spot patterns, trends and anomalies, and help explain what they mean in practice. Use modern data and analytics tools to turn raw data into clear, actionable outputs — reports, dashboards and analytics that support broker lineslips / facilities and senior management, both regular and ad-hoc. Support the use of AI-enabled tools to automate repetitive data entry, cleansing and reconciliation, and to accelerate the production of reports and analytics. Collaborate with data, technology and analytics teams across the wider group. Apply appropriate human review, document your work and follow best-practice data and AI standards. Break problems into steps an agent can execute, and use good judgement about when to lean on AI and when to do the work yourself. What You’ll Grow Into As you build aviation domain knowledge and technical depth, the role broadens to include: Acting as a data and analytics point of contact for the team’s lineslip portfolio — building and maintaining reporting suites covering bordereaux, income, claims and utilisation. Producing consolidated, portfolio-level analytics to support renewal strategy and market presentations. Identifying data-quality issues in lineslip records and working with brokers to resolve them at source. Acting as a business-analyst liaison between the broking team and IT / AI development resources — defining requirements, mapping workflows and setting data-capture standards. Participating in testing (UAT) and supporting brokers using AI-enabled tools: troubleshooting, onboarding users and maintaining guides and training materials. What We’re Looking For Essential A degree (or equivalent) in a numerate or analytical subject — e.g. maths, statistics, data science, economics, engineering or sciences. Strong attention to detail and logical thinking. A genuine interest in how data can influence business decisions. Confidence explaining ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences. An inquisitive, problem-solving mindset — comfortable with modern AI tooling and keen to keep pace with a fast-moving landscape. Technical skills (you don’t need all of these on day one) Experience using Excel for analysis. Exposure to Python, SQL and/or R through study, projects or internships. Familiarity with data-visualisation tools such as Power BI (or similar). Interest in learning modern data platforms (e.g. Databricks). Experience using GenAI / LLMs to support operational workflows and analytics. Any exposure to automation tools (e.g. Power Automate) and to producing presentation materials is an advantage. Nice to have (but not required) University or personal projects involving real datasets. A basic understanding of data modelling or data pipelines. An interest in — or willingness to learn — insurance and aviation. Domain knowledge can be developed on the job. Key Stakeholders Emma Roberts and the wider Aviation team. Aviation brokers and client executives. Markets / insurers (indirectly, through placement data and reporting). Central Data & Analytics team; IT / AI development teams. Operations teams. How Success Will Be Measured Accuracy and timeliness of reporting. Quality and usefulness of data insights. Data quality and completeness across the aviation portfolio. Growing confidence and independence with the data platform and analytical tooling. Adoption and effectiveness of AI-enabled tools in day-to-day work. Progress against agreed learning and development goals. Tools & Systems (Typical) Microsoft Excel. Power BI. SQL / data lake (e.g. Databricks). Power Automate / Power Platform. SharePoint / Dataverse GenAI tools (e.g. Copilot / Claude) for reporting and process support. What You’ll Get A structured early-career role with on-the-job learning and mentoring. Exposure to client and operations work across a specialist line of business. Training and professional qualifications (e.g. Chartered Insurance Institute). Competitive salary, generous pension and private medical cover. What do we offer in return? A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us: Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond Reasonable adjustments We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*. If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require. *Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more. Permanent Howden began in 1994, as just three people and a dog. Now there are 23,000 of us, and we're a leading global insurance group, managing $37bn of premiums for our clients. Our largest shareholder group is us – the people who work in the business – supported by three long-term, minority growth-equity partners who share our vision to build a business to last, one that will never be sold. The owner's mindset is something that's embedded in our culture; our people readily take ownership of their decisions, their actions, and their outputs. They’re invested in every sense. And we all know that by working together to drive the business forward, everyone will benefit from the extraordinary results we can achieve.

jobs_results.title: Bureau Data Analyst Lead
jobs_results.description:
Location: Kings Hill / Hybrid


Salary/package: £32,126.17 per annum


Contract type: Permanent


Hours: Full time, 37 hours per week


As a Bureau Data Analyst Lead, you will lead a team of Bureau Data Analysts who deliver reporting, analysis and insight to public sector customers across energy and utilities. This is an opportunity to shape and influence a growing service, ensuring customers receive high-quality reporting while helping the business continuously improve and innovate.



This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced people manager who is passionate about data, continuous improvement and delivering great service outcomes. You'll lead and develop a growing team, use insight to inform decision-making and play a key role in shaping the future direction of the bureau service, with a visible impact across the wider organisation.


Who we are
LASER Energy's mission is to deliver unique end-to-end solutions that help reduce energy costs and support the public sector on their journey to net zero.


As the leading provider of decarbonisation and energy services to the public sector, our goal is to always push the boundaries; we’ll explore new solutions and technologies to make sure the journey to net zero grows ever-greener and always more efficient – for us and our customers. All the while we strive to deliver on our goals, we also recognise how important it is to create an inviting, colourful place for our employees to work.


Why this role matters
As the lead for the Bureau Data Analyst team, you'll drive service excellence, identify opportunities for improvement and help shape the future direction of the service. You'll empower and develop a team of analysts, using data and insight to strengthen decision-making, improve customer experience and support the delivery of an evolving, market-leading service.


What you’ll be doing
Leading and develop a team of Bureau Data Analysts to deliver excellent customer outcomes.


Manage team performance, workload planning and delivery against service standards and deadlines.


Support colleagues through coaching, mentoring and ongoing development conversations.


Ensure reporting outputs meet high standards of quality, consistency and accuracy.


Challenge existing processes to identify opportunities to improve services and customer outcomes.


Developing new service opportunities that add value for existing and future customers.


Managing escalations and supporting the resolution of complex operational challenges.


Providing performance reporting and insight to support decision making and future service development.


What we’re looking for
Proven experience managing and developing successful teams.


Strong experience working with data, reporting and performance information.


The ability to challenge processes, identify opportunities and drive positive change.


Experience implementing service improvements and delivering measurable outcomes.


Experience managing operational performance, quality standards and delivery targets.


Good Microsoft Excel and Power BI skills.


A proactive, inquisitive and solutions-focused approach with a desire to continuously improve services.


Energy industry experience would be beneficial but is not essential. We are more interested in candidates with strong leadership, data and service improvement experience.


What you’ll get in return
Salary of £32,126.17 per annum.


25 days annual leave, increasing to 27 after four years.


Birthday Day Off.


One Concessionary Day off during the Christmas Period.


Life assurance cover 4x salary.


Pension scheme with 4% employer contribution.


Additional benefits including retail and gym discounts, health cash plan and cycle to work scheme.


Volunteer days and access to a comprehensive wellbeing programme.


Tailored development support with real opportunities to progress.


Access to Learning & Development opportunities via our CSG Academy.


Hybrid working.


Why CSG?
CSG is the UK’s largest local authority-owned trading company (LATCO), generating over £700 million in revenue per annum and supporting more than 16,000 education and public sector customers globally.


We are growing through a combination of organic development, acquisitions and strategic partnerships. Our 35+ businesses deliver services across education, IT, HR, legal, energy, procurement and more, all focused on delivering meaningful impact.


As a locally owned organisation, we take pride in reinvesting a significant proportion of our profits into frontline services, helping strengthen the communities we serve.


Inclusion & Accessibility
We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We encourage applications from suitably qualified people of all backgrounds.


As a member of Inclusive Employers with Silver Accreditation, we are actively building an environment that supports inclusion, flexibility and belonging for all colleagues.


We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout our application and interview process; please let us know if you require any.

jobs_results.title: Business Analyst - Chief Data Office
jobs_results.description:
Barclays’ Chief Data Office is seeking an experienced Business Analyst who combines strong data literacy, business and data architecture awareness and process re-engineering expertise with a proven track record of delivering complex change within large financial services organisations. The ideal candidate will be comfortable navigating a SAFe delivery environment, working across multiple Agile teams and stakeholder groups to translate strategic objectives into sustainable business outcomes. They will be equally adept at analysing data, redesigning processes, shaping requirements, influencing senior stakeholders and partnering with architecture and engineering teams to deliver enterprise-scale transformation. 

 

To be successful in this role, you should have sounded knowledge and skills in:


Proven Business Analysis experience delivering large-scale business and technology transformation programmes within complex, highly regulated financial services organisations.  Strong experience working within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment, including Programme Increment (PI) planning, backlog refinement, feature definition, dependency management and cross-functional delivery.  Strong understanding of data management, data architecture, governance, lineage, metadata and regulatory data requirements.  Experience leading business process redesign, target operating model development and organisational change initiatives.  Ability to engage effectively with business and technical stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership, architects, engineers and data professionals.  Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to use data to identify issues, generate insights and support decision-making.  Experience using JIRA, Confluence, Visio, MS Project and Microsoft Office applications.  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

 

This role will be based out of Glasgow.

 Purpose of the role

To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities. 


Accountabilities

Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.
Vice President Expectations

To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.
All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave..

jobs_results.title: Senior Data Analyst (12 Month FTC)

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst (Spanish Speaker)
jobs_results.description:
This is a remote position.

   The Data Analyst plays a critical role in transforming data into reliable business intelligence for the Spanish organization.     
    

   The role supports operational performance, financial control, customer and merchant insights, and evidence-based decision-making across a transaction-intensive business environment.     
    

   You will partner with Business, Finance, Operations, Product, Technology, Data Engineering, and Data Governance teams to consolidate information from multiple platforms, define trusted KPIs, investigate discrepancies, and provide a consistent view of customers, transactions, billing, and operational processes.     
    

   The position also contributes to ongoing data transformation initiatives while ensuring strong standards around data governance, quality, security, and documentation.     
    

   Key Responsibilities     
       Business Partnership & Decision Support     
                Collect, challenge, and translate business needs into clear analytical questions, metrics, dashboards, and data products.       
      

             Partner with business and functional teams to understand performance drivers and provide insight-led recommendations.       
      

             Deliver recurring and ad-hoc analysis supporting operational decisions, growth initiatives, service quality, and management reporting.       
      

             Clearly communicate findings, assumptions, limitations, and recommended actions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.       
      

          Data Analysis, Integration & Reconciliation     
                Analyze and reconcile data from multiple systems, databases, files, and external partners.       
      

             Identify gaps and inconsistencies between different data sources.       
      

             Investigate discrepancies and perform root-cause analysis, particularly across transaction, payment, ordering, billing, invoicing, and financial-control processes.       
      

             Design and maintain unified analytical datasets and repeatable controls providing a reliable and traceable view of business activity.       
      

             Collaborate with Data Engineering and source-system owners to define transformation rules, resolve data defects, and improve data availability.       
      

          Analytics, Business Intelligence & Reporting     
                Develop, maintain, and optimize operational and management dashboards, primarily using Power BI and, where relevant, Qlik Sense, Metabase, or comparable BI tools.       
      

             Use advanced SQL to query, transform, validate, and analyze large datasets.       
      

             Apply Python and/or R for statistical analysis, automation, or repeatable analytical processing.       
      

             Create meaningful visualizations and data stories that make complex findings understandable and actionable.       
      

             Apply analytical and statistical techniques including:       
      

                  Trend analysis         
        

                   Segmentation         
        

                   Forecasting         
        

                   Regression         
        

                   Control sampling         
        

                   Anomaly detection         
        

                     KPI Definition, Data Governance & Quality     
                Define and document business metrics and KPIs, including calculation rules, ownership, source systems, refresh frequency, and quality thresholds.       
      

             Contribute to data glossary, metadata, data lineage, and master-data initiatives.       
      

             Establish and monitor data-quality controls covering completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, and traceability.       
      

             Ensure data is handled in accordance with security, privacy, access-control, retention, and regulatory requirements.       
      

          Collaboration & Delivery     
                Work closely with local and international stakeholders across Data Engineering, Architecture, Security, Data Governance, Finance, Operations, Product, and Technology.       
      

             Contribute to data integration, platform migration, and reporting-modernization initiatives.       
      

             Ensure continuity of KPIs, reporting, and controls during system or platform transitions.       
      

             Maintain clear documentation for datasets, dashboards, analytical models, business rules, and controls.       
      

             Manage priorities transparently and contribute to agile planning and delivery processes.       
      

             Take ownership of agreed analytical outcomes.       
      

              
   

    
     Requirements            Minimum 3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a comparable analytical role.       
      

             Demonstrated experience working with multiple data sources and translating business questions into robust analytical and reporting solutions.       
      

             Experience with data integration, migration, reconciliation, or data-quality improvement initiatives is highly valued.       
      

             Experience within multinational, digital, fintech, payments, retail, employee-benefits, or other transaction-intensive environments is advantageous.       
      

          Technical Skills     
                Advanced SQL, including:       
      

                  Complex queries         
        

                   Data transformation         
        

                   Data validation         
        

                   Performance awareness         
        

                   Database optimization         
        

                        Strong hands-on experience with Power BI.       
      

             Knowledge of Qlik Sense, Metabase, or comparable visualization platforms is advantageous.       
      

             Working knowledge of Python and/or R for data analysis, automation, and statistical modelling.       
      

             Understanding of analytical data modelling concepts including:       
      

                  Star schemas         
        

                   Slowly changing dimensions         
        

                   Dashboard-ready semantic models         
        

                        Knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, metadata, data lineage, and KPI-management practices.       
      

             Experience with ClickHouse is a plus.       
      

             Understanding of hybrid or cloud data architectures, ideally within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem, is advantageous.       
      

          Education     
       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant quantitative discipline.     
    

   Languages     
                Fluent Spanish – required       
      

             Professional English – required       
      

             French, Portuguese, or additional European languages are an advantage.       
      

          Key Competencies     
                Strong data analysis and reconciliation skills       
      

             Business Intelligence and data visualization       
      

             Statistical and analytical modelling       
      

             Business process understanding and KPI design       
      

             Data governance and data quality       
      

             Data integration and source-to-target mapping       
      

             Root-cause analysis and problem solving       
      

             Strong analytical thinking and curiosity       
      

             Accountability and ownership       
      

             Attention to detail       
      

             Strong stakeholder collaboration       
      

             Ability to explain complex data topics in clear business language       
      

             Adaptability and continuous learning       
      

             Ability to use AI-enabled analytical tools responsibly to support analysis and automation       
      

              
   

    
     Benefits            Based in EU      


             Remote      


             Collaboration with international teams and stakeholders across different time zones      


             B2B Contract

jobs_results.title: Insight Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Job Introduction

Purpose


Turn disparate project and financial data into clear, proactive insight - linking trends, early warnings, and predictive signals to decisions made by senior stakeholders and the leadership team. You’ll work with and around existing reporting requirements, adding analysis that explains the “why” and “what next,” not just the “what.”


Key Outcomes


Early warning: Detect leading indicators of cost/schedule variance, risk exposure, and delivery slippage before they surface in monthly reporting.
Predictive view: Build light‑weight forecasts and scenarios that quantify impact and recommend mitigations.
Decision support: Deliver concise, executive‑ready narratives (one‑pagers, briefings) that drive action.
What You’ll Do


Analyse large, multi‑source datasets (cost, schedule, risk, change, progress) to uncover trends, drivers, and anomalies.
Perform time‑series, regression, variance and sensitivity analyses; translate results into clear recommendations.
Create fit‑for‑purpose visuals (e.g., small-multiple charts, run‑charts, control charts) to evidence findings - no “dashboard factory.”
Define and track leading KPIs and thresholds; set up alerts and watchlists for emerging risks.
Partner with PMO/Project Controls/Finance to align insights with the reporting cycle and governance forums.
Improve data quality and consistency; shape simple data models that make recurring analysis faster.



Flexible working: We welcome you to ask about the flexibility you need. This might be part-time, remote working, or compressed hours for example. Anyone who applies for a role can ask about flexibility at interview. In return, we will explore what is possible for the role.


The Ideal Candidate

What You’ll Bring


Strong analytical toolkit: advanced Excel (modelling, Power Query, complex formulas), sound statistics, and storytelling with data.
Working knowledge of Power BI for light modelling/visuals (deep dashboard development not required).
Ability to join the dots across data, context, and delivery realities; crisp written and verbal communication for senior audiences.
Experience operating in fast‑paced project environments and influencing through evidence.
Nice to Have (Desirable, not essential)


Project Controls background (EV, cost & schedule analytics, trends, PMB, WBS) and/or Finance (budgeting, forecasting, variance).
Ability to interpret Primavera P6 outputs (logic, slippage, float) and link schedule signals to cost/risk.
Exposure to major infrastructure programmes.
SQL and/or basic Python/R for heavier analysis or repeatable workflows
Demonstrable experience in the development of reports and dashboards to a diverse set of stakeholders in a fast paced environmen
Highly skilled in mainstream BI tools (including but not limited to Power BI
Understand and promote data qualit
Knowledge or experience with Extract Transform Load (ETL
Knowledge with Azure integration services
About The Company

The role will work on the HS2 project. HS2 is the UK’s new high speed rail network. It will be a catalyst for economic growth across Britain, freeing up space on the existing railways and connecting 8 out of the UK’s 10 biggest cities with fast, reliable and frequent high speed services


The Skanska | Costain | STRABAG (SCS JV) is delivering the HS2 London Tunnels Contract. Scope of works includes twin-bored tunnels (TBM), SCL tunnels, shaft sinking, bridge demolition and reconstruction, services diversions, earthworks and the construction of site compounds.


You’ll be a welcomed member of the wider team, with opportunities to take on additional responsibility, join our EDI Champions program or support the local community (e.g. as a STEM ambassador).


Your personal and professional development is important to us. We welcome a discussion about how we can support you with further study, or professional membership or attainment for example.


HS2 – working with Skanska, Costain and STRABAG, closely monitors job applications, to ensure an inclusive recruitment process. To ensure we are able to maintain this, and to recruit a diverse workforce, we require candidates to complete the diversity form as part of their application so we are able to monitor and improve our approach to diversity. Please note, all responses are anonymous and we will not share any of your data with other parties. All data will be held securely, (as stated within the Data Protection Act 2018 and UK GDPR) and will be reported to HS2.

Develop a culture of safety on the project through the absolute commitment to the Zero Accidents target and ethos, and develops a wider awareness of quality, environmental issues and demonstrates commitment to achieve continual improvement and Zero tolerance.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. we do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation


SCS Railways is a Disability Confident Leader. We want to encourage disabled people to apply for our roles and have an opportunity to display your skills, talent, and abilities. We will ensure that a fair and proportionate number of disabled applicants that meet the minimum criteria for this position will be offered an interview.


Please see the disability confident commitments:


https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/disability-confident-guidance-for-levels-1-2-and-3/level-1-disability-confident-committed

A physical or mental impairment, which has a substantial and long-term effect (over 12 months) adverse effect on your ability to carry out normal day-to-day activities

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst/Scientist or Senior Data Analyst/Scientist
jobs_results.job_title: Data Analyst/Scientist or Senior Data Analyst/Scientist
jobs_results.description:
Bristol or London
About Us
Hoare Lea is a human-centric and planet-conscious engineering consultancy. We offer intelligent and sustainable solutions to complex design challenges for the built environment throughout the UK and further afield.


We provide a wide range of engineering and consultancy services, including acoustics, air quality, building services (MEP), fire, lighting, security and sustainability to name but a few. Together, our highly skilled teams use technical expertise and problem-solving skills to bring buildings to life. We ensure that whatever the building, its design is outstanding, and its operations meet the needs of the communities it serves.


We are as committed to providing an environment where everyone can realise their unique potential. So, in joining Hoare Lea, you will experience a business that enriches your knowledge, supports your wellbeing, and welcomes your individuality. You’ll have the opportunity to participate in our 9-day fortnight scheme, thriving community groups, varied social and networking events, and extensive professional and technical development schemes.


We also offer an extensive benefits package, including private medical cover, an electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme, stock options, and 25 days of annual leave (increasing with service), alongside flexible and hybrid working.


Whatever your ambitions or circumstances, our aim is to enable everyone to develop their knowledge, give their best, and enjoy what they do.


About The Role
Our multi-disciplinary software, product, and data team serves as a central hub of digital expertise and innovation, supporting projects across the company. We work collaboratively with engineers, consultants and other specialists to use data and technology to solve real-world problems and improve the services we provide to our clients.


We have an opportunity for a Data Analyst/Scientist or Senior Data Analyst/Scientist to play a key role in using data, analytics, statistical methods and data science to generate insight, support decision-making and improve our engineering services.


This is a broad analytical role. You will work across the full lifecycle of a problem: understanding stakeholder needs, exploring and assessing data, identifying appropriate analytical approaches, communicating findings and, where appropriate, developing statistical or machine-learning models or client-ready insights/tools. This is a role for someone who enjoys variety and has a critical eye for finding the right solution for the problem.


Sometimes this may be exploratory analysis, a dashboard or a set of clearly defined metrics; in other cases, it may involve forecasting, statistical modelling, machine learning or building/working with AI.


It's an exciting time to join our Digital team. Working alongside a range of specialist engineers and consultants, you will be joining a collaborative, knowledgeable, highly engaged team, and offer a supportive, flexible, and high-performing work culture. In a time where building and energy resilience is ever more important, we are driving forward innovation to make an impact with data and technology.


You will have the opportunity to engage in a variety of high-impact projects, working on challenging problems for some of the UK’s most notable organisations, including the NHS and Oxford University. Our team has recently worked on creating data science-led for managing estates in hospitals, building energy forecasting models, and harnessing data on building performance to create better designed buildings of the future.


In this key and varied role, you can expect to:



Work with engineers, consultants, product teams and other stakeholders to understand their needs and translate sometimes ambiguous questions into well-defined analytical problems.
Develop and implement data-driven solutions to solve real-world business problems across the company.
Use SQL, Python and other analytical tools to investigate datasets, identify trends and relationships, test hypotheses and generate actionable insights.
Apply appropriate statistical techniques, forecasting methods, ML and AI approaches where they add value to the problem being solved.
Collaborate with the product and software engineering teams to turn analytical work into reusable tools, workflows and data-driven products where appropriate.
Develop reproducible and maintainable analytical code, following best practices, including version control, testing, and peer reviews.
Contribute to the development of analytical and data science capability across the business by sharing approaches, reusable methods and good practice

About You
To be successful in this role you’ll need:
Essential Skills

Experience applying data and analysis to real-world business, engineering or operational problems.
Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to take an initially ambiguous question and determine an appropriate analytical approach.
Ability to work on projects independently and own deliverables.
Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, visualisation and data science (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
Proficiency in data querying languages (e.g., SQL). Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (version control, unit testing, code review, etc.).
Strong experience with data visualisation frameworks (e.g., PowerBI, Streamlit).
Experience applying machine learning and AI, including generative AI, to real-world problems where it provides clear benefit.
Familiarity with statistical concepts and their application in data analysis.
Solid communication skills, capable of effectively engaging with and presenting findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Understanding of data governance, privacy, responsible AI and other relevant standards.

Desirable Skills

Knowledge of the engineering industry and its challenges.
Experience with one of the major machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
Knowledge of mathematical optimisation methods, such as linear, integer or constraint optimisation, and associated tools (e.g. OR-Tools).
Experience with MS Fabric or equivalent data warehousing solution.
Experience working in a cloud computing environment.
Familiarity with containerisation and deployment technologies (e.g., Docker, CI/CD pipelines).

For candidates joining at
Senior
level, we would additionally expect you to lead more complex or ambiguous analytical projects, shape analytical approaches and overarching priorities, work independently with senior stakeholders, review and support the work of others, and help raise analytical standards across the team.
How To Apply
To apply simply complete a CV profile and submit your application.
If shortlisted, one of our recruitment team will be in touch to arrange an introductory call (about 30 minutes) to discuss the role and your experience in more detail. From there, successful candidates will be invited to attend a panel interview, either via Microsoft Teams or in person at one of our offices. We aim to provide feedback at each stage of the process.


Adjustments and accommodations
If there are adjustments or accommodations that we can put in place to help you participate and give your best at any stage of the recruitment process (whether relating to disability, neurodivergence or anything else) please let us know.


Data privacy
We have updated our terms and conditions for candidates, click here to find out more.


Recruitment agencies
We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners who assist us when required. We do not acknowledge speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

jobs_results.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. 

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
 
GTM Insights Analyst - GTM Analytics
Why We Have This Role



The Qualtrics GTM Planning & Insights team is looking for a GTM analyst who wants to make an impact on a fast-growing business, can conduct in depth analytics and reporting, and can make strategic recommendations for the company. This role is essential to enabling our go-to-market revenue operations and surfacing valuable insights on opportunity areas to our field teams.

How You’ll Find Success



Analytical and data-oriented, with great troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Has an eye for quality and scalability.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively.
Ensures accuracy of work through attention to detail.
Takes initiative, learns quickly, understands expected outcomes, absorbs context, and works proactively to get results.

How You’ll Grow



Grow your data analysis, problem solving, and communication  skills across while developing expertise in sales and go-to-market operations.  
Learn how global sales, customer success, and marketing teams operate, and improve the data/systems/insights that drive their growth
Opportunity to help build a team and function team from the ground up

Things You’ll Do



Perform quantitative and qualitative analysis leading to actionable insights, assisting stakeholders throughout the business on special projects / reports.
Handle inbound requests from field teams for data analysis, data requests, and decision making support. Proactively work with internal stakeholders to prioritize needs and/or requests on a weekly basis.  
Transform complex data sets into actionable insights using analytical, visualization, and data tools such as Tableau, Excel, Python, R, MySQL, etc.  Create queries, views, reports, and easy-to-consumption dashboards/visualizations.  
Own end-to-end problem solving efforts from the discovery & exploration phase through to implementation.
Own an entire area of go-to-market operations: taking projects from start to finish with high quality and impact, acting as the “subject-matter-expert”, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure the analytics are being used to drive business outcomes.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume



2-7 years experience in visual reporting tools such as Tableau; experience with SQL and data manipulation/transformation
Relevant experience with sales operations, associated CRM systems (i.e. salesforce.com or SAP C4C), or sales planning processes is a plus
Able to deal with ambiguity in a fast-paced growth environment, manage strict SLAs and communicate effectively to a global audience
Degree from a top-tier university with a quantitative or systems focus (e.g. informations systems, computer science, STEM, business analytics, finance, data science)

What You Should Know About This Team




GTM Planning & Insights plays a critical role in managing the operating rhythm of our global go-to-market field teams.
Core responsibilities include territory planning, quota setting, pipeline and capacity health, customer health, performance management, and customer journey analytics.
If you are ready for a new high-impact challenge, we encourage you to apply.


Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits



https://www.qualtrics.com/careers/us/en/emea-benefits 
Fully funded private medical and dental insurance through Bupa for you and your dependents
Wellness reimbursement of up to £300 gross per quarter to support wellness activities for you and your family 
Income protection in the event of prolonged illness providing for 66% of salary after 13 weeks of illness
Company pension plan with a 5% employee salary sacrifice contribution and a 9% employer contribution
Commuter assistance of up to £5,000 gross per annum paid monthly via payroll to assist with your costs of commuting to and from the office
Employee Equity Purchase Plan allowing you to buy into Qualtrics’ equity and participate in the success of the company over time 
Annual Leave - 25 days per annum plus an additional day of annual leave for each year of service, up to a total of 5 additional days
Additional leave programs to support you and your family
Annual Experience Bonus of £1,450 after one year of employment 
Adoption and surrogacy reimbursement up to  £8,200
Referral bonus 
Resources on topics such as childcare, elder care, parenting, household needs, pet care, moving and relocation, community resources, volunteer opportunities, and more
Career Action Plans
Mentorship programs
Resources on topics such as interpersonal skills, work-life balance, stress management, time management, and more 

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid
